messages:
infra-bot: INCIDENT alert - 1729456789 - High cross-region routing errors: increased p95 latency and 5xx spike for requests routed to eu-north-1 via latency policy. Impacting ~4% of requests. Paging on-call.

pagerduty: Paging eli (on-call, eng-sre) for INCIDENT #INC-2024-378. Please acknowledge.

eli: acknowledged. looking.

maya: i can help — running sigcheck now. seeing a bunch of 502s coming from frontend-edge proxies when they get routed to eu-north-1.

eli: timeline? when did this start?

maya: started ~10:16 UTC per tracing. p95 latency jumped from 120ms to ~900ms for the affected subset.

hana: i pulled a sample trace: user requests are being pinned to eu-north-1 because the latency-based policy computed region scores using stale probe results. looks like the probe service returned stuck values for a ~5m window.

eli: ah ok. is probe refresh failing or are we mis-evaluating pins?

hana: probe agent process on controller-a had errors: `EOF reading from probe stream`, then we resumed. caching TTL for region-scores is 2m, but we saw a pin-sync daemon applying scores that were >10m old due to a queue backlog.

kevin: can we force a re-eval of routing decisions? any hotfix available in control plane?

eli: yes — we have a pin-sync override endpoint. plan: 1) temporarily disable latency-based pinning for region-policy 'latency-weighted' 2) trigger immediate recompute of region-scores 3) enable a conservative fallback that prefers region affinity when scores ambiguous.

maya: +1. what's the command? safety check first.

eli: running: `POST /admin/routing/overrides` payload: "{ \"policy\": \"latency-weighted\", \"action\": \"disable\", \"reason\": \"INC-2024-378 - temporary disable to stop misroutes\" }" — doing it now.

infra-bot: admin routing override accepted (req id req_9f3c). Policy latency-weighted disabled. All new region decisions will skip latency-based pins.

hana: re-eval job queued. forcing immediate recompute: `rdrwctl routing recompute --all-regions --force`

kevin: system logs: `recompute: start`, probes now reporting fresh latencies. i'm seeing region-scores stabilized and pins removed for flows that were incorrectly stuck.

maya: traffic shifting back to expected regions. errors on affected requests dropping.

ops-shiftlead: notif to customer-success: some customers saw elevated latencies, CS to triage top affected tenants. (reacted :eyes:)

customer-success-bot: Notifying top-10 customers that may have seen increased latency between 10:16-10:28 UTC. Draft message queued for review.

eli: validation checks: p95 restored to ~140ms for those flows, 5xx rate back to normal baseline. keeping override in place until we confirm probe stability for 15m.

hana: root cause hypothesis: probe agent backlog due to GC pause + burst of probe targets after a deployment. probe stream handler didn't drop old values and the pin-sync daemon applied queued outdated scores. propose: add TTL enforcement and a freshness check before applying pins.

kevin: agree. i'll open a follow-up engineering ticket for probe agent resilience and add a short-term mitigation: cap queue length and drop entries older than 30s.

maya: on-call handoff note: i'm taking primary follow-up for the next hour to watch churn and roll any hotfix if needed. eli do you want to stay on watch for escalation?

eli: i'll stay available. handoff to maya in 1m. leaving bridge: #incident-1729456789-bridge.

maya: creating post-incident checklist: - revert override after probe health ok - deploy queue-cap patch to probe agent - add metrics alert for stale-probe-queue - customer notification follow-ups

ops-shiftlead: ETA to revert override?

hana: once we observe 15m of healthy probe samples and no pin drift alerts, plan to re-enable latency-weighted policy with a gradual ramp over 5m. estimated earliest revert ~10:55 UTC.

infra-bot: ATTENTION: scheduled rolling restart of controller-a in 20m for unrelated maintenance. postponing until incident cleared. (reacted :warning:)

customer-success-bot: CS message sent to affected tenants. feedback channel created: cs-prod-1729456789.

eli: closing action for on-call: document timeline and add to postmortem. forwarding to eng-postmortems.

maya: ack. i'll keep monitoring and capture logs for postmortem. handover complete.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2024-378 acknowledged by eli and transferred to maya (on-call). status: monitoring. next update in 15m or on change.

infra-bot: INCIDENT update (1729456789) - mitigated (routing override active). follow-ups assigned: ENG-PRB-1729, SRE-1729. last update 1729460520.
